name: @lemoncloud/flow-engine
description: Headless flow engine — graph editing, undo/redo, snapshot/diff, and the execution-state reducer, with no DOM and no framework

scripts.prepack: rm -rf build && tsc -p tsconfig.pkg.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=build/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=build/index.cjs && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > build/package.json
